newsitem.title: USA: Onyx files for $100 mln debt offering.
newsitem.headline: Onyx files for $100 mln debt offering.

text.p: Onyx Acceptance Corp said Tuesday it filed an amended registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell an increased amount of auto-loan pass-through certificates, series 1996-4.

In the amended filing, Onyx said it raised the amount to $100 million from $1 million. In practice, companies often amend registration statements later on to reflect a bigger amount of securities to be sold.
The offering in the Irvine, Calif., company will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, the filing said.
Onyx is in the business of providing indirect automobile financing to new car dealerships and selected used car dealerships within California, and to an increasing degree in other Western states.
